name: LiveProof
author: Shaon Bahadur

sections.description:
LiveProof – Sales Notification for WooCommerce

Get instant updates from your WooCommerce store with real-time notifications for every sale, new cart addition, and product review. A slide-up window can appear from the bottom left, right, or center, fully configurable in the admin dashboard. Control how many orders display, and choose whether to show cart additions or reviews.

Feature:

  1. Real-time notifications for sales, cart additions, and product reviews
  2. Slide-up window display from bottom left, right, or center
  3. Fully configurable settings from the admin dashboard
  4. Set the number of orders to show in the slide-up window
  5. Enable or disable cart addition and review notifications
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. In the search bar, type “LiveProof” and press Enter
  4. Locate the LiveProof plugin, click Install, wait for the installation to complete, then click Activate
  5. LiveProof is now installed and ready for configuration—congratulations!
  6. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → LiveProof to configure your plugin settings — this step is crucial before the plugin becomes active.
